activities.title: Oral Language Development: Community Circle Time
activities.content:
Greeting
• Welcome pupils and have them sit in a circle. 
• Say: Tooŋaal funakaf ñetum kasaafoorak. Wulaal kásaafoorum ñetum kañenak kúridak.   
 Anoosani ayiten kañenak koola kúrudak.
• Check to make sure every pupil is holding up the right hand.
• Say: Nanoosani nusaafumi bukanak, nujiker wuulaw wooliil jak, nuwonk ureesaw wooliil ban  
  nusaafiil..
• Turn to the pupil on your right, shake their hand.
• Say:  Saafuul, (nuwonk kareesak kati aliikenaaw).
• Pupil should respond back saying "Good morning, teacher."
• Have the pupil that was just greeted, turn to the pupil on their right and greet them. 
• This continues all the way around the circle.
Theme Discussion
• Before school starts, bring in two items related to the theme to show the pupils. Put the   
items in the center of the circle. If no items are available, draw two pictures on the board   
instead.
• Say: Di funoomaf ufe, fúkaaf fati kaliikitenak koololaal ' KAFATAK.' Wahaw wammi di fucaabaf 
ufe ugoroorugoroor di fúkaaf faŋ fo.
• Hold up one of the items from the center of the circle. 
• Say: Ure waawu?
• Call on a pupil at random to answer.
• Say: Waawu nuŋoolene uregom mati ure?
• Call on 2-3 pupils at random to answer. Repeat with the second item.
• Say: `Ure búrom waawu sigoroore di 'kafatak'?
• Give pupils one minute to think, even close their eyes to picture their response. Then     
choose one of the following options for discussion: call on pupils at random, Turn and Talk  
 (have pupils turn to a pupil next to them), go around the circle and allow every pupil to 
answer (only if the answer is short), or have pupils take turns acting out answers.
• Encourage pupils to bring in their own items relating to the theme throughout the week.

activities.title: Learning Sounds
activities.content:
Identify Sounds: What Sound Am I Making?
•    Say: ''Ínje bee ebil ikaan uyel. Jimoyen man jiraagal máamak di eñes bee emanj waawu niŋare       
      man ikaan uyelaw uwe."
• Pupils close their eyes. Make a sound (example: tap desk with pencil, close the door, slide 
chair across floor, drop a book on the table). Then call on a pupil at random to describe 
the sound and guess what was used to make the sound. Call on another pupil if first was   
incorrect. Continue with another sound.

activities.title: Letter of the Week
activities.content:
Learning Letter: "a"
• Write the small letter "a" very big on the board. Point to the letter.
• Say: Pan úcimaal kácim, (mba nuregaal kurim kariiboore). Pan rambenolaal man liikitenolaal 
man siciikaas sololaal sinenimi eeno épur fútaagul be di fútaagul. Moo pan rambenolaal man 
uliikitenaal siciikaas soololaal.
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times 
slowly.

• Write the capital letter "A" very big on the board. Point to the capital letter.
• Say: Uye eciika yákon. Yoo poop eyelemi /a/. Nujukaajuk mati di fútooŋumaf fati furimaf, 
kareesak kati anaw, mba kareesak kati banab too kayelak kútoogummi.
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times 
slowly.
• Point to the small letter "a" on the board or letter card again.
• Say: Ñameeŋe, pan ujukaal yo man ebile di kurimak.

activities.title: Writing
activities.content:
Fine Motor Development
• Say: Pan úliŋenaal ucilaw wammi di uñenaw di siniilas soololaal. Moo pan rambenolaal di 
eciikey jooŋoor. Man ucilaw ufaŋ man úliŋe di uñenaw woololaal, moo pan faŋ man jake di 
kájeetikenak kati uñenaw woololaal nampi ulakoami eciikey. 
• Exercise is marching: standing in place the opposite arm swings forward to the raised knee 
(left arm and right knee together). As pupils march on the spot, give orders: low march knees 
raised slightly), normal march (knees raised to half raised), high march (knees raised as high as 
possible), left turn, right turn, face forward.
• Alternative exercise is the crab walk: (make sure the ground is not dirty so pupils do not soil 
their clothes) sit on the ground with legs extended out in front, place hands by side with 
fingers pointed toward feet, lift body up into the air, start moving forward or backwards. Have 
pupils try for one minute then have them stop and rest for a minute. 
• Then have them try again for another minute.

lessons.homework: Ask learners to teach their family members the letter name and sound they learnt today.

activities.title: Vocabulary
activities.content:
Teach and Discuss New Words
• Words: 
Eñeraay    Bánaanaay
• Say: Uliikitenaal kurimak kunkulak man ufaŋaale man úlawulaale karegak máamak. Babaj 
kurim kápanloe kaceeŋumi man umanjaal di karegak.
• Say the first vocabulary word, but do NOT write it on the board. Then have pupils say the word 
aloud. Repeat two more times.
• Ask pupils what they know about the word. Share the meaning of the word, using gestures or 
illustrations to support understanding. 
• If needed, help pupils understand the word by saying it in another language.
• Repeat all steps with remaining word.

activities.title: Reason to Read
activities.content:
Learn New Print Concepts
•    Think about how we read a book. Show the cover.
• Say: Nanoosani nulakoami  eliikey, wulaal bee etooŋ fatiya bee tentaam (point with your 
hand), bamoyab bee di báridab (point with your hand) karesak kati búkaay.  Wulaal káwupul 
utojaw wati búkaay kápurum fáculey bee bálamukab. (demonstrate).
• Have pupils follow the motions as you show on the book TOP to BOTTOM and RIGHT to LEFT 
and turn pages FRONT to BACK.

activities.title: Comprehension: During Reading
activities.content:
Making Predictions: Picture Walk 
• Say: "Nanoosani nujikeraale uwuloorumaaw wariiboorumi di karegak, pan rampenolaal di  
kanoolen man karegak kootumi ejaay eeno, doo eenomi katiimalen waate kabajo. Niceen  
katiimalen kuceen pan kaan mo, niceen let kaan mo, maamaama nujikerumi babaj fúkaw. 
Aliikitenaaw alegenaw pan aŋoolen atiimalen waatumi kabajoak di karegak.

• Read the title of the story. Look at the illustration.
• Say: "Di buwuloorumab nijujuk áriiŋaaw man aake kaliŋ kati bánaanaay fatiyaay yati 
burepulab bati bánaanaay". Ínje di síwoonoorom , karegak wan kúyiisenumi woo emmi, 
"áriiŋaaw namammaŋ bee eri bánaanaay. Mo'om niwoonoorumi mati áriiŋaaw ombo najikere 
kaliŋak kati bánaanaay ban nandi kawoonoor buu naate emiinul ko eeno."  
• Continue through the book. Stop at each picture but do not read the story.
• Say: "Nanoosani nujuke buwuloorumab ban siriiboorumi di karegak, di síwoonoori, waawu 
woote kabajo?"
• Give pupils less than a minute to look, then call on a pupil at random asking for their 
prediction. Then call on another pupil at random asking for their prediction. If pupils are 
having difficulty making a prediction, share one of your own.
Vocabulary Review
• On the pages that have a vocabulary word, stop and draw pupil attention to the word.
• Say: "Tótey  nujukaale furimaf 'bánaanaay' di buwuloorumab?"
• Call on a pupil at random. Affirm the correct answer or attempt, let them know if it is correct, 
and clarify the answer. If pupils have trouble finding the word in the picture, remind them of 
the meaning of the word.

lessons.homework: Ask learners to teach their family members the new vocabulary words they learnt today.

Name Card #1
• Before the lesson, create two name cards for each pupil with their first name.
• Give each pupil their name card and you keep the other set. 
• Say: Aama, ayito ajuum. Jiker kareesak kooli di kayitak. Pan icaŋ karees, kooñam mante 
riibooriiboor di kareesak kooli. Riiboorujaat di kareesak kooli, nubil.  Riiboorutujaat di kareesak 
kooli nulako.
• Hold up a name card and walk around so every pupil can see the name. Once there is a   
match, continue with another name. Do as many names as possible in time allotted.
• If pupils are having difficulties, say the name written on the card.

Then read the page. 
• Say: Ñaa, mante batiimalenerab boololaal moo?
• Provide feedback. Continue through the story.

Eñeraay di bánaanaay
Karim simit futok nabaje. Oomu di kalaakak bare mati bacaar bookool nájukumi bánaanaay 
yaroojumi. Karim nalaañum ajikerumi kumangaak koo poop kurorooj.
Eñera jahiikun di épurelo to fús. Najikeruyomi nawoonoor. Eñeraay di etujulomi bánaanaay esen 
Karim.
Karim nammi yo, "Emit ecaami Eñeraay!" Eñeraay di etujulomi fumangaaf esenool, nammi yo, 
"Emit ecaami!."
Eñeraay yahiikunaay di ejukumi elemunaay, di katekelak di fúsiilaf. Eñeraay etookut katekelak di 
fúsiilaf. Karim naŋarumi kañenak koola anenumi di butumab boola ban nammi, "tunten!" Karim 
najawumi di fúsiilaf man ábajulomi elemunaay yammi di mukammaam ban natey bee tíiyeŋey 
man asen Eñeraay. Eñeraay di eyiten fúkaaf fooliyo ban di ereg, "Emit ekati!" ban di ejaw ewubo. 
Karim nalaañumi ajiker bánaanaay nabooko ajiker fúmangaaf di kaanool nan apaalo alaañ 
ápureloo to fúfus man atujulool fumangaaf. Bare buyaasab ube eñeraay elañuloot.

vocabulary word. 
• Read the sentence with the word. Point to the word and say it out loud. Have pupils repeat 
the word. Say the definition. 
• Repeat with the next vocabulary word

"SILUUPAS SANAAMUTAS"
Mariyaama di ésukey yati fatiya nacine. Kalimbisak koola bateepe mof man kuciin ko kasondak 
kati mujit. Mariyaama nammi, "Ínje nimaŋmaŋ síndaay yumboom".
Funak fákon, Mariyaama ampaol nabil ejukiil. Oo di ésuk yáamake nacine.
Mariyaama naceeŋ ampaol, "síndeey yooli buu yoonoye?" 
Ampaol naanool, "bacine di kalimbis kabaake di kiil kajupoe". Síndaay yumboom ebabaj fukuk 
fáliŋe di sítoofen sati siweer. Bacine di fank fáamak. Mariyaama ajeloorool Faatu, kapanak kati 
falaf nicine. Mariyaama ajaw ejukool. Kalimbisak koola símuunas sabaake sipebe ko fatiyaaf fati 
mumelam.
Mariyaam naceeŋ, "buukaane kalimbisak kooli di kutebo fatiyaay?" Faatu nammi, "nampi falaf 
fumeeŋulomi di fujamaraaf, mumelam karemboorul be fatiyaay. Símuunaas soo sipakenemi 
kalimbisak di kásuloak"!
Mariyaama najaw ajuk apaalool Laamini. Fiilaf foola kumata kafaatooremi di síbees sooliil.
Laamini di cecebey nacine yan kujoonene ñatum kunukak, ebúkey, mujitam di ubasaaw.  Laamini 
naane, "koo kafenden sibees." "Wuli kajawoor di úlimbisaw wóoleli."
Mariyaama nawoonoor mati sísindaas búrom. Nammi, "sísindees búrom sinaamut, bare bukanak 
búrom, kulakoelako di sísindaas sooliil jak di kásuumaay".
Sísindees búrom sijajak nan sipakenumi fiilaf fooliil.

again for another minute.

• Say:  Uye eciikaay yoololaal yati funoomaf ufe. Eciikaay uye kayelak kooliyo /i/ Jiregaal /i/ 
siñakon.
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times 
slowly.
• Write the capital letter "I" very big on the board. Point to the capital letter.
• Say: Uye eciikaay yákoney /i/. Yo poop ekanekaan kayelak /i/. Pan ujukaal di fútoogumaf fati 
kasankenak, kareesak kati anaw mba banab.
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times 
slowly.
• Point to the small letter "i" on the board or letter card or on the board again.
• Say: Ñameeŋe pan ujukaal yo mo`omu di kurimak.

Learning Writing Concepts

Then release and shake hands for 10 seconds. Repeat two more times.
• Give each pupil a pencil and demonstrate the proper way to hold a pencil.
• Say: Nampi uciikaami, nuciikaal épurem bamoy bee bárid di poop épurum fatiya bee tentaam. 
Nannaam nan esofey yati eciikumaay mansi upumen kañenak di móro.

kayitak.

specific motions like dashes or loops. Look around and make sure pupils are going in the 
proper direction (left to right, then moving down as if moving to a new line).
• Say: Ñaa ulanlankenaal di sítaabulas. Jiŋar waaf man jikaan nan eciikumaay man jítooŋum 
fatiya bee tentaam épurul di egooleney yati kañen kumoy fatiya. Jíjeetim uñenaw wooluul nan 
eciik jombo di táabuley. Nampi jíriiŋumi di fúbanumaf di jiŋar karang kuceen. Jiruulen eciikey 
kápurum bamoy bee bárid, fatiya bee tentaam.
• Walk around and make sure pupils are demonstrating correct direction of writing. Continue to 
the next line, stopping to check pupil progress before going on.

activities.content:
Making Predictions: Illustration
• Show the illustration. Read the title while pointing to each word. 
• Say: Jijikeraal buwuloorumab . Waawu nujukaale?

prediction. After the answer, ask why they made the prediction.

activities.content:

• Read aloud the story. Stop after a few pages/sentences.
• Say: Jimoyen man jiwoonoor furim di úwejetuul. Waawu jijuke?

Jánlo amaŋut afinto ámoori
Jánlo balakoe fúreeraf nabakoor di jimotaaj joola jíreediumaaj. Ama¿ut ejaay afinto. Iñaamoola 
naanoomi, "jaw ufinto." Oo narunlenumi fúreeraf di jimotaaj joola. Iñaamoola naanoomi,

activities.content:

if that's what happened? After the response, affirm the correct answer or attempt, let them 
know if it is correct, and clarify the answer.

them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer.
